acts.name: Kansas
acts.mood: gray and drained of colour, flat prairie light, everything weathered to the same dust tone
acts.source: Ch. I: 'the great gray prairie... the sun had baked the plowed land into a gray mass'; Aunt Em 'gray also'.

acts.name: Munchkin Country
acts.mood: saturated storybook blues and greens, bright clear daylight, tidy and welcoming
acts.source: Ch. II: 'a country of marvelous beauty... banks of gorgeous flowers... birds with rare and brilliant plumage... a brook rushing and sparkling', explicitly contrasted with 'the dry, gray prairies'. Blue is the Munchkins' colour.

acts.name: The Road and the Emerald City
acts.mood: open country under wide sky, deepening toward green as the city nears, grand but airless inside the walls
acts.source: Ch. XI: 'Everything is green here, while in the country of the Munchkins blue was the favorite color'; the green spectacles are locked on every visitor.

acts.name: The Winkie Campaign
acts.mood: hard yellow light over bare country, then the castle: cold stone, long shadows, menace held just off frame
acts.source: Ch. XII: the country grows 'rougher and hillier, for there were no farms nor houses in this country of the West'; the Witch's castle and her single telescope eye.

acts.name: The Road South
acts.mood: strange and various - fighting trees dark and knotted, the china country delicate and doll-lit, Glinda's country serene
acts.source: Ch. XX-XXII: the fighting trees, the delicate china country, the Hammer-Heads, then Glinda's country 'covered with the beautiful flowers'.
